origine_fr: Une main 扌 et, à droite, 舌, la langue, qui a pris la place d'une partie qui donnait le son. 舌 se lit shé et ne donne pas le son de kuò. 括, c'est lier, serrer ensemble : englober, puis les parenthèses, 括号.
origine_en: A hand 扌 and, on the right, 舌, the tongue, which took the place of a part that gave the sound. 舌 is read shé and does not give the sound of kuò. 括 means to tie, to bind together: to include, then brackets, 括号.

phrase.zh: 包括我在内，一共五个人。
phrase.pinyin: Bāokuò wǒ zài nèi, yīgòng wǔ gè rén.
phrase.en: Including me, there are five of us.
